_comment: INF-05: one binary-cache configuration with two backends behind one interface. Public identifiers and placeholders only: a placeholder such as @CACHIX_PUBLIC_KEY@ stands for a value the owner creates in the cache dashboard, and scripts/verify-binary-cache.mjs --release refuses every placeholder. No token, password or account identifier is written here; tokens live in environments and are recorded by holder in docs/RENEWALS.md.
